jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(C) inventory: Paine Mountain School District, a unified union district in the Central Vermont Supervisory Union (member towns: Northfield, Williamstown). Operates PK-12.

sources.note: Paine Mountain SD board page (official; footer "updated 10.5.26"): seven seats -- Northfield 4, Williamstown 3 -- with holders and terms: Van Deren (Williamstown, Chair) Mar 2024-2027; Path (Northfield) 2024-2027; one Northfield seat labeled VACANT (2024-2027 cohort); Morris (Northfield, Vice Chair) 2025-2028; Duke (Williamstown) 2025-2028; Macijeski (Northfield, Clerk) 2026-2029; Dwinell (Williamstown) 2026-2029. Election model is proportional (town-only electorates): Williamstown's signed Jan. 21, 2026 warning elects "Two (2) Williamstown School Directors each for a Three (3) Year Term" by Australian ballot in Williamstown; Northfield's 2025 warning mirrors it. FLAG (carried, not smoothed): the warnings seat three directors per year but the page's 2025 and 2026 cohorts hold only two each -- one winner per year is unaccounted for (prime candidate: Horace Duke, whose published 2025-2028 span would be 2026-2029 if he was the second 2026 Williamstown winner). Resolving documents: the Williamstown School Meeting Minutes of March 3, 2026 (town-posted, unscanned-text fetch failed), the Northfield 2026 minutes, and the district's March 2026 reorganization minutes.

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates). The Northfield post's fourth seat is a district-acknowledged vacancy (the board page's own label, 2024-2027 cohort).
